note: INDEPENDENT ground truth (TESTING.md §6, review 2026-06-29; corpus grown 2026-08-13 with REAL cited public commits). Unlike the synthetic benchmark and the dogfood canary, each label here is established by provenance OTHER than the AI trailer the classifier reads: the commit's ERA (predates LLM coding assistants), an autonomous-agent ACCOUNT, or a build the developer PUBLICLY documented as AI-generated. `untrailered: true` marks the real-world blind spot — AI the classifier fails to flag as AI-involved despite no trailer. This is now purely the no-signal class: inline autocomplete / stripped trailers / AI committed under a human's name — irrecoverable without session-log evidence (#68). (A second sub-cause once lived here — an AI-agent identity DISCARDED because its GitHub noreply email embeds '[bot]', so bot-precedence beat the AI-identity match, e.g. real Devin commits — but that was RECOVERED on 2026-08-13 by a classify.ts precedence refinement, so those cases are now `ai`/detected, not blind.) Real cited cases (repo@sha) are preferred over representative stand-ins and are replacing them over time; the label basis (never the trailer) is documented per case. The corpus grows via captured corrections (#69) and real labeled repos.
